brief:
Three years after the October 7 attack on Israel, Hamas faces a critical reckoning as the militant group confronts severe strategic losses, Zeteo reported. Palestinian political analyst Muhammad Shehada assessed how the organization reached this juncture and the implications for the broader Palestinian movement.

The analysis examines the trajectory that led to Hamas's current position and considers what comes next for a group fundamentally weakened by military defeats and the destruction of its infrastructure across Gaza.
dek: The militant group is reckoning with a strategic disaster. Palestinian political analyst Muhammad Shehada breaks down how the group got here and what it means for the movement today.
title: Hamas reels from strategic collapse three years after October 7 attack
